stories.title: 📜 Gospel of Bartholomew
summaryBullets: After the resurrection, Bartholomew asks Jesus to reveal the hidden mysteries of his descent (section 1).
The disciples fear to hear, but Jesus grants Bartholomew alone the boldness to ask (section 1).
Jesus recounts how he descended into Hades to free Adam and the righteous (section 2).
Michael the archangel pleaded for mercy, and Jesus broke open the gates of death (section 2).
Hades trembles at Jesus’ approach, and Beliar warns that their defeat is at hand (section 3).
The gates of Hades open, and Jesus brings out the patriarchs and prophets (section 3).
The angel of vengeance rends the Temple veil, signifying access to God (section 3).
The cosmic order shakes at the descent and rising of Christ (section 3).
Jesus reveals that daily many souls ascend, though only some enter Abraham’s bosom (section 4).
He receives their offerings as a sacrifice in paradise (section 4).
Christ sits in glory and accepts the praises of the redeemed (section 4).
Bartholomew marvels at the mystery of salvation and sacrifice (section 4).
The apostles ask Mary to recount the Annunciation and Incarnation (section 5).
Mary prays a hymn; cosmic trembling and a great sign appear (section 5).
Jesus manifests in light and reorders reality after her prayer (section 5).
Mary’s testimony confirms the mystery of the Word becoming flesh (section 5).
Bartholomew invokes Christ’s power and confronts Beliar, who is forced to appear (section 6).
Beliar confesses his rebellion, his dominion over demons, and his dread of Christ (section 6).
Jesus commands that these mysteries be kept from unbelievers (section 6).
The text ends with Bartholomew and the apostles glorifying Christ and blessing the assembly (section 6).
crossRefs: 1 Peter 3:19 — Preached to the spirits in prison.
Ephesians 4:9 — He descended to the lower regions.
Matthew 27:52–53 — Tombs opened and saints raised.

translationNotes.original: Hebrew: שְׁאוֹל (Sheol) — Greek: ᾅδης (Hádēs) — Aramaic: שאול (Sheol)
translationNotes.note: The underworld or realm of the dead; depicted as the place Jesus descended to free the righteous.

stories.keyTakeaway: Bartholomew asks Jesus about hidden mysteries, and Jesus begins describing his descent into Hades.
